title: fix: fallback to raw text instead of rendering *Unsupported markdown*
body: ## :bookmark_tabs: Summary Instead of saying "Unsupported markdown", we show the raw text when `htmlLabels: true` (the default behavior) Before After Resolves # ## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions Prevents data loss ### :clipboard: Tasks Make sure you - [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html) - [x] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests. - [x] :notebook: have added documentation. comments.body:
**suggestion(optional)**: I'm still a big fan of adding more description to make it even more clear what the fix is without making people look at the PR for more details, but it's up to you.

```suggestion
fix: fallback to raw text instead of rendering _Unsupported markdown_

Instead of printing **Unsupported markdown: XXX** when using a markdown feature
that Mermaid does not yet support when `htmlLabels: true` (default),
fallback to the raw markdown text.
```
comments.label_reasoning: The comment suggests improving the changeset/changelog description to better document what the fix does, which is a documentation quality concern.
